_about: Prompts for tools/generate_sfx.py. Each entry names a game event, never another game. kind: oneshot (trimmed, peak-normalized) or loop (seamless, loudness-normalized). voice entries use text-to-speech plus a radio filter. steps entries are sliced into single footsteps and an even walking loop.
